From e2521b2a8baabdaf43b92192588f51e042d21e97 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Steve Rowe <sarowe@apache.org>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2017 15:36:50 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-9596: Add Solr support for SimpleTextCodec, via
 <codecFactory class=solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory/> in solrconfig.xml
 (per-field specification in the schema is not possible).


diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index 8f1fe870254..81288d8eee2 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -196,6 +196,9 @@ New Features
 
 * SOLR-10521: introducing sort=childfield(field) asc for searching by {!parent} (Mikhail Khludnev) 
 
+* SOLR-9596: Add Solr support for SimpleTextCodec, via <codecFactory class="solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory"/>
+  in solrconfig.xml (per-field specification in the schema is not possible). (Steve Rowe)
+
 Optimizations
 ----------------------
 

diff --git a/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml b/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
index 6cf1ab175f4..61387b980d7 100644
--- a/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
+++ b/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
@@ -32,5 +32,6 @@
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="join" />
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="sandbox" />
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="backward-codecs" />
+    <orderEntry type="module" module-name="codecs" />
   </component>
 </module>

### Modifications Summary

#### Changes in Each File

1. **solr/CHANGES.txt**
   - A new entry has been added to document the addition of support for `SimpleTextCodec` in Solr. This entry notes that users can now specify `<codecFactory class="solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory"/>` in `solrconfig.xml`, although per-field specification in the schema is not supported.

2. **dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml**
   - An additional module entry has been added: `<orderEntry type="module" module-name="codecs" />`. This change implies that the project now includes the `codecs` module, which is likely necessary for the new codec support.

#### Relationships
- The modification in `solr/CHANGES.txt` serves as documentation for the new feature introduced in Solr, providing users with information on how to implement the `SimpleTextCodec`. 
- The change in the `solr-core.iml` file is a structural update that supports the introduction of the `SimpleTextCodec`, indicating that the `codecs` module needs to be included in the project's dependencies to utilize the new codec functionality. This relationship emphasizes that the addition of features in Solr necessitates corresponding adjustments in the project structure to ensure proper integration and functionality.
